component.name: CANExplorer
component.summary: Monitor, analyse, diagnose and simulate CAN, CAN FD and LIN buses

description.p: CANExplorer is a cross-platform workbench for CAN, CAN FD and LIN buses, for engineers, tuners and hobbyists working on vehicles and embedded networks. It works with any python-can adapter, or on a virtual bus with no hardware at all.

ul.li: Live trace and dashboard with decoded signals (DBC, DBF, ARXML, KCD, SYM, LDF), frame rates, bus load and the busiest identifiers, handling millions of frames.
Signal plots with cursors and CSV export, and bus health: error states, TEC/REC and load over time.
Recording and replay in ASC, BLF, CSV, candump LOG, PEAK TRC, SQLite, ASAM MF4 and gzip, with triggered and split recording, replay onto a bus, and recording comparison.
Reverse engineering of an unknown bus: bit and byte statistics, automatic detection of checksums, counters, multiplexers and values, reference signals, and a scripting console.
Diagnostics and protocols: UDS over ISO-TP, ECU flashing, DoIP, J1939, CANopen, XCP/CCP, GMLAN and GM Class 2 (SAE J1850 VPW), with simulated ECUs to try without hardware.
A signal database editor for CAN and LIN, and conversion between the formats.
Simulated nodes with control panels, and test automation with HTML and JUnit reports for CI.
Remote buses, MQTT publishing, six colour themes and a command palette.
